q: How much electricity does a Guntur chilli cold storage use per tonne stored?
title: Chilli cold storage: kWh per tonne
short: Divide monthly kWh by the tonne-months stored. A store using 60,000 kWh while holding 5,000 tonnes uses 12 kWh per tonne-month, about 8.5 kg CO2. Refrigerant top-ups are Scope 1 and can add more than people expect.
audience: Chilli and spice cold storages in Guntur and nearby

ul: Ambient heat: summer months use more.

p: Kg topped up × the refrigerant's GWP gives Scope 1. Ammonia has no GWP; HFCs have high ones.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including kVAh, demand and solar export lines, into dated records with the units, factor and year behind every Scope 2 figure.
